_meta.purpose: Slice lane: four single-dimension design-readiness rounds, blocking 1/1/1/1. Rounds 3 and 4 share the 2026-07-30_13-30-07 basename (slice-fix amended in place), so basename-mode grouping merges them into ONE current round — the merged fold keeps the newest verdict per dimension and cannot manufacture a waiver. Two pinned readings over the same rows: the guard simulation over derived per-round counts (halts at re-entry 4, max 3, under both guards) and the verbatim slice-lane panel hook (unknown/unchanged/unchanged/unchanged — the merged basename run never improves).
_meta.excerpt_rule: Trail lines 5-27 in verbatim order: every slice-check row, every slice-grade verdict row, every slice-fix row (round delimiters AND the artifact-basename regenerations the freshness fold reads), all routing rows, and the halt row. The pre-excerpt slice row (trail line 4, the initial 13-06-15 map) is outside the range; the first round folds with no slices channel entry.
_meta.channel_rule: Each stage row bakes its outcome channel in `channel` (derived from the workflow's outcome map so the replay needs no workflow introspection): slice-check->slice-check; slice-grade->slice-verdicts; slice-fix->slices.
_meta.trim_rule: Stage rows keep stageNumber/stage/channel plus the fold-read fields only: slice-grade verdict rows keep dimension/pass/severity/artifact and findings trimmed to the first finding {detail}; slice-check rows keep dimension/pass/severity; slice-fix rows keep the slices fs handle + slice_count. Dropped: score/graded_at/feedback/kind/meta/ts, risk_rulings, verdict rows own artifacts array. Routing rows keep type/fromStage/decision verbatim. The halt row is normalized to the new kind {type:halt,stage,errMsg} with errMsg verbatim.
_meta.row_format: compact one-row-per-line JSON (each rows[] element on a single line)

findings.detail: Slice 2 under-cites for coverage item c9. pick-a-path.md is a living guide (frontmatter section: guides, order: 0, cross-linked from the cited run-a-workflow.md:29) and its line 28 states build is a '(19 stages)' chain ending 'implement → validate → commit', omitting implement-scope-check and reconcile — the exact drift c9 ('living guides no longer state build is a 19-stage pipeline') claims to eliminate — yet it is in neither Draws on nor Out of scope. A design-slice pass reads only the cited file:line seeds, so it would not touch pick-a-path.md and c9 ships unmet. Its vet chain at :30 also omits goal/implement-scope-check/reconcile.

Slice 2's 'three-of-five' reframing is under-cited: it lists 4 'three pipelines' locations in Draws-on (workflows.ts:2, pick-a-path.md:27, run-a-workflow.md:29, WorkflowCatalog.astro:35) but its own coverage item c9 ('guides no longer state ... ships only three pipelines') spans 9 more living-source 'three bundled pipelines' references left un-cited: run-a-workflow.md:3 (frontmatter), :27 (heading, 2 lines above the cited :29), :128, :136; compose-skills-as-skills.md:10 and :254; how-a-workflow-works.md:233; workflows.ts:118; and the WorkflowCatalog.astro:2 comment (same file as the cited :35 h2). design-slice does NO discovery and reads only cited lines, so it would reframe :29 to 'three-of-five' while the adjacent :27 heading and same-file :128/:136 prose still read 'three bundled pipelines' — an internally inconsistent half-fix that cannot fully deliver c9. Verified the numerical side is sound: the live graph is build=30 / vet=8 / polish=6 (the slice's 19->30, 5->8, 23->30 are all correct), and every '19' marker in living source IS cited (only the immutable release-note + blog-post '19's are un-cited, correctly fenced as out-of-scope). The gap is confined to the 'three pipelines' framing fan-out. Slice 1 is fully cited and passes: every one of its 13 citations resolves and matches the claim, ship/arch/polish descriptions are accurate (only vet/build drift, exactly as scoped), the single pr-triage ref is at :3838, and IMPLEMENT_PLANS_FANOUT's comment is not drifted — no under-citation.

Slice 2 declares the runtime graph as its ground truth (its Depends-on note says it reads the runtime graph directly as ground truth, same source Slice 1 reads) but its Draws on cites zero built-in-workflows.ts lines. design-slice reads ONLY the cited file:lines, so it cannot derive the build/vet counts (30/8) it must write into the mirror, nor reconstruct the corrected build stage chain for the guides (run-a-workflow.md:33, pick-a-path.md:28) or place goal/implement-scope-check/reconcile in the correct vet spine order (c7). The slice even enumerates which stages the guide chains are missing but never gives the full ordered chain, so the design pass must read the graph -- which is un-cited. Add the build stages block (~built-in-workflows.ts:3710-3905) and the vet stages block (~:3645-3668) to Slice 2's Draws on.

Slice 1 late-file Draws-on cites are stale by ~50-75 lines: built-in-workflows.ts grew since the research, and the re-slice refreshed Slice 2's runtime-graph cites (vetWorkflow :3696-3772, buildWorkflow :3774-4144, descriptions :3699/:3777) but left Slice 1 untouched, so the artifact now cites the same vet description at two different lines (Slice 1 :3623 vs Slice 2 :3699). 7 of 13 load-bearing cites resolve to unrelated code, misdirecting a no-discovery design-slice pass. built-in-workflows.ts: :3623 (claims vetWorkflow.description, lands on codeVerdictOutcome plumbing), :3651 (claims vet DAG-fanout use, lands on a path-resolution block), :3660 (claims reconcile reuses build run-function, lands on a validate-dispatch comment), :3701 (claims buildWorkflow.description, lands on vet's description text), :3893 (claims build implement-scope-check floor, lands on a subplans lineage comment). built-in-workflows.test.ts: :3838 (claims dead pr-triage guard comment, lands on an unrelated subplan-verdict test), :4929 (claims loop.concurrency assertion, lands on an unrelated verdict-idempotency test).
